settings.label: Minimum confidence
settings.help: Detections less sure than this are dropped. Higher: fewer, surer grains. The same value as Filter by confidence on the Detect tab.

authors.source: Soloy et al. (2020), the threshold used in the paper

settings.label: Duplicate removal (IoU)
settings.help: A grain found twice where tiles overlap is kept once when the two overlap at least this much. Higher: fewer merges; 0: none. The same value as Dedup IoU on the Detect tab.

fixed.label: Trained weights
fixed.reason: the model of Soloy et al. (2020), trained on clasts; PebbleMapper ships no other.
